mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_outbox_events (event_id, occurred_at, topic, ordering_key, trace_id, event_snapshot, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{row.eventId}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.topic}, #{row.orderingKey}, #{row.traceId}, CAST(#{row.eventSnapshot} AS JSONB), #{row.occurredAt})
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT current.event_id FROM iam_outbox_events current WHERE current.published_at IS NULL AND current.next_attempt_at <= #{at} AND (current.claimed_until IS NULL OR current.claimed_until <= #{at}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_outbox_events earlier WHERE earlier.ordering_key = current.ordering_key AND earlier.published_at IS NULL AND (earlier.occurred_at, earlier.event_id) < (current.occurred_at, current.event_id) ) ORDER BY current.occurred_at, current.event_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE iam_outbox_events event SET claimed_by = #{claimant}, claimed_until = #{claimedUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 FROM candidate WHERE event.event_id = candidate.event_id RETURNING event.event_id, event.occurred_at, event.topic, event.ordering_key, event.trace_id, event.event_snapshot::TEXT AS event_snapshot, event.claimed_by, event.attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_outbox_events SET published_at = #{publishedAt}, claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND claimed_by = #{claimant} AND published_at IS NULL
